description: This class is a final validator for EntityTagMatcher values, used within the Eclipse Ditto project to validate header values for headers that require EntityTagMatcher instances. It extends an abstract header value validator, providing conditional validation logic and factory methods.

classes.name: EntityTagMatcherValueValidator
classes.description: A final class that validates whether a given CharSequence is a valid EntityTagMatcher value, throwing an exception if validation fails. Implements singleton-like creation methods and uses a predicate to determine responsibility.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of EntityTagMatcherValueValidator with default predicate (responsible for EntityTagMatcher).

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns an instance of EntityTagMatcherValueValidator with a specified predicate to determine responsibility.

methods.name: validateValue
methods.description: Validates the given CharSequence value using EntityTagMatcher.isValid(). Throws DittoHeaderInvalidException if invalid.
